playbooks.label: Callable acceptance can verify a bounded patch
playbooks.safe_next_step: run verifier gates against sandbox patch package

playbooks.label: Positive sample failed because a domain fixture is missing
playbooks.safe_next_step: add or select a controlled fixture/profile and re-run blind acceptance

playbooks.label: Optional dependency boundary requires a controlled profile
playbooks.safe_next_step: add a generated module or metadata profile only when import is external

playbooks.label: Acceptance contract does not bind to callable signature
playbooks.safe_next_step: send contract binding back to Implementer Planner or Spec Writer

playbooks.label: Import-time runtime behavior is not a safe executor patch target
playbooks.safe_next_step: isolate import-time side effects or choose a lighter target

playbooks.label: Bound method requires a controlled instance fixture
playbooks.safe_next_step: build a bounded instance fixture or rebind to a callable boundary

playbooks.label: Nested closure is not a standalone patch target
playbooks.safe_next_step: rebind to the enclosing callable or provide explicit closure inputs
